mapper.select: SELECT U.*, A.LOGIN_TYPE AS loginType FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN AUTH_ACCOUNT A ON (U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT U.*, A.LOGIN_TYPE AS loginType FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN AUTH_ACCOUNT A ON (U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) WHERE LOWER(U.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = CASE WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - LAST_LOGIN) >= 30 THEN 'H' ELSE STATUS END, LAST_LOGIN = CASE WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - LAST_LOGIN) < 30 THEN CURRENT_DATE WHEN LAST_LOGIN IS NULL THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE LAST_LOGIN END WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE USERS SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, STATUS = 'Y', LAST_LOGIN = CASE WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - LAST_LOGIN) >= 30 THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE LAST_LOGIN END WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE USERS SET USER_NAME = COALESCE(#{userName}, USER_NAME), EMAIL = COALESCE(#{email}, EMAIL) WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = 'N', WITHDRAW_REASON = #{withdrawReason}, EMAIL = NULL, LOGIN_ID = LOGIN_ID || '_del' || USER_ID WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
mapper.select: SELECT U.*, A.LOGIN_TYPE AS loginType FROM USERS U JOIN AUTH_ACCOUNT A ON (U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) WHERE A.PROVIDER_USER_ID = #{providerUserId} AND A.LOGIN_TYPE = 'KAKAO'

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, A.LOGIN_TYPE AS loginType FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN AUTH_ACCOUNT A ON (U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) WHERE LOWER(U.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND U.STATUS = 'Y' AND (A.LOGIN_TYPE IS NULL OR A.LOGIN_TYPE = 'LOCAL')
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET LOCK_UNTIL = NULL, LOGIN_COUNT = 0 WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
